residual.wall: Six products hide under “procedural mesh generation.” Gasper already has one: a locked polar constructor. The shatter on Goose was a second product — generating paint faces from the field.

question: What kinds of procedural mesh generation exist, which of them are lawful on a cage whose topology is frozen, and what would “more mesh” actually mean for Gasper?
coordinateSpaces: Polar cage: u = sector/40, v = ring/25. Contour: θ on 512. Lattice: 15×24. Screen: SVG user units. World: 1920×1080. Counts are computed: verts = rings×sectors; tris = (rings−1)×sectors×2. 25×40 = 1000. 15×24 = 360. Do not transpose u/v.
physicalLaw: C = Γ(L) + Σs_i. Topology is identity. Shape is an embedding.
createPolarTopology runs once. It does not run per frame.
A field on 1000 is not a new mesh. Extracting isosurfaces or subdividing is.
artisticLaw: He puffs, pebbles, or becomes a remote by changing Σs_i, not by growing triangles.
Paint primitives (ellipses, tiles) are not the cage. Tiles read as crystal. Pebbles read as skin.
LOD is two locked topologies (360 and 1000), not a runtime remesh.

families.name: Fixed polar cage
families.what: rings×sectors, stagger, two tris per quad. Built once.

families.name: Displacement on a cage
families.what: SOTA (Lee/Ahn/Lee): one control mesh + a displacement map for the whole animation.

families.name: Catmull-Clark / Loop subdivision
families.what: Each pass multiplies faces. Entertainment default for a base mesh.

families.name: SDF / marching cubes / metaballs
families.what: Oracle → new triangles every time the field changes. Blowfish temptation.
families.have: Nothing. Puff is pressure on the same 1000.

families.name: Skin / envelope along a rig
families.what: Blender Skin, feature-anim envelopes. Generate a hull from a skeleton.
families.have: Wispwalker nubs are lobes on ring 24, not a generated hull.

families.name: MeshGPT / VertexRegen / MeshAnything
families.what: Autoregressive or diffusion meshes. Offline asset generation.

families.name: shadeLitMesh / per-vertex stipple
families.what: Treat each 25×40 cell or vertex as a face or speckle. 588 tiles = the shatter.
families.have: Live for non-goose relief. Goose now uses goosebumpsSkinPaths (~84 ellipses).
families.lawful: shade as intensity only; unlawful as a second body

Explore does not recut the painter.

Catmull-Clark the 512 so the W looks smoother (new silhouette law).
Calling shadeLitMesh a procedural mesh and shipping 588 tiles as skin.

If Work is approved: denser Σs_i (more gaussians, regional τ), not more vertices.
